【原视频简介】
She spent 2,000 euros to buy a 25-year-old house—and her neighbor immediately came over to warn her
   A young woman spent 2,000 euros to purchase a house that had been abandoned for 25 years. As soon as she decided to buy it, a neighbor rushed over to warn her against proceeding. Yet, despite the warnings, she decided to keep the property and began planning its renovation.

She contacted us, asking our cleanup crew to help clear the entire garden and surrounding grounds. Upon arrival, we were truly shocked by the scene before us. After 25 years of neglect, thick, tall weeds choked the yard, vines blanketed large areas, and overgrown bushes had all but swallowed the pathways. Piles of trash, dried leaves, broken branches, and all manner of discarded items lay scattered about.

Our first task was to clear away the dense overgrowth to uncover the original paths. We split up, using lawnmowers, shears, machetes, and specialized tools to remove the wild vegetation that had taken over the grounds over the years. Large bags of waste were collected, sorted, and hauled away.

After hours of continuous work, the garden began to undergo a remarkable transformation. Areas once hidden by weeds emerged, pathways opened up, and the massive piles of debris were cleared. Although the work was grueling, it was incredibly rewarding to see a seemingly forgotten property coming back to life.

But this is just the beginning. There is still much work to be done to turn this long-abandoned house into a clean, livable home…
metadata.title: 旧屋改造：2000欧买下荒废25年的老宅，邻居竟然跑来劝退
